title: 14층까지의 자화상
suno_analysis_sp: K-Pop Funk-Pop. Slap bass performs syncopated sixteenth-note patterns. Clean electric guitar plays percussive muted strums and rhythmic ninth chords. Acoustic piano provides bright staccato chord stabs. Electronic drums feature a crisp snare and a tight, punchy kick. Male vocals utilize a rhythmic, melodic delivery with frequent use of falsetto in the higher register. Key of G Major. Tempo is 118 BPM. 4/4 time signature. Brass section hits emphasize the downbeats during the chorus. Synthesizer pads provide harmonic sustain in the background.
